# pkg.hold

Mark or unmark packages as held to prevent upgrade/removal (apt + dnf on linux, brew on darwin)

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `manager` | string | No | - |
| `name` | string | No | - |
| `names` | array | No | - |
| `state` | string | No | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin

## Events Emitted

- `package.managed`
